name: Warm Bone Broth Mug (Chicken or Beef)
whyItWorks: Sipping salted chicken or beef bone broth with a drop of toasted sesame oil or ground ginger restores sodium and hydrates an inflamed gut faster than plain water.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat 1 cup bone broth on the stovetop with a pinch of sea salt and 1 drop toasted sesame oil.
